capabilities: Navigate PDF pages with zathura-style keys, counts, zoom, rotation and search
Recolor PDFs for dark reading and toggle a per-file status bar
Set per-file marks and reopen PDFs at the last page read
Open a study split placing the PDF beside a note and scroll it from the note
Open PDFs in an external reader such as zathura with file and page arguments
extras: Not yet in the community plugin list; install via BRAT or manually from a GitHub release. Desktop only. Recolor, status bar, marks and last pages are stored per device to avoid sync conflicts.
motivation: To read PDFs, even whole books, without touching the mouse.
problem: Obsidian's PDF view relies on the mouse and toolbar, with no zathura-style keyboard navigation, recoloring or reading-position memory.

relations.evidence: With Vim Motions, its leader sequences (Space f f…) still work from a PDF
Read PDFs in Obsidian like it's zathura.

summary: Keyboard-driven PDF reader that adds zathura-style keys, dark recolor, marks, a status bar, last-page memory and a PDF-plus-note study split.
